3. Adverse Event Narrative
A 22-year-old male received Dose 2 of mRNA-1273 (Spikevax) on 12 February 2025. Approximately 8 day(s) following vaccination, the patient developed symptoms consistent with Urticaria. The patient sought medical attention and was managed outpatient. The outcome was recovered without sequelae. The reporter does not consider the event related to mRNA-1273 vaccination.
